answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond that is slashed when the identity is proven fake, and scale the bond with each extra identity tied to the same device or payment trail, so a lotus of sockpuppets costs far more per head than one honest account. Require a cipher of independent attestations: peers vouch only after real interaction, and a voucher loses its own bond if its vouchee is later proven fake. Add a wharf of rate limits so bursts of fresh identities earn nothing until they age and act. Attackers must then fund, age, and behave plausibly for every fake.
